svg.title: Who is on a payroll run — SoftTrack web design mockup (#320)
svg.desc: A payroll draft puts every active account on the run, so a client’s guest account and the seeded demo account are listed as missing pay on every run. With an employment type on the account, a draft lists the people on payroll, names the accounts it left off, and the missing warning is about somebody whose pay should have been recorded.
svg.text: Who is on a payroll run
· people who are paid, and a warning that can be cleared
